cv_text: Candidate for Frontend Engineer. Skills: React, TypeScript, CSS, accessibility, Vite.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.content_text: Welcome. Tell me about your experience as a Frontend Engineer.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.content_text: I have several years building frontend engineer systems with React and TypeScript. Recently I led a project improving throughput using CSS.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.content_text: Describe a hard problem you solved and the trade-offs you weighed.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.content_text: We hit a scaling bottleneck; I profiled it, isolated the hot path, and redesigned it with accessibility. The trade-off was added complexity, justified by a 4x latency win.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.content_text: How do you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.content_text: I frame decisions around user impact and cost, use diagrams, and confirm understanding by restating the agreed plan.
